decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England)  Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B, D and E in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Preliminary Ecological Assessment (Ref. ASW/JS/004/28/2024), Arboricultural Impact Assessment (Ref. GHA/DS/162240:24a), Arboricultural Impact Assessment Rev C, Design Statement, Tree Constraints Plan, Tree Protection Plan Rev B, Heritage Statement, (Ref. 2402.1453), 1467/P/1A, 1467/P/2, 1467/P/3, 1467/P/4, 1467/P/5, 1467/P/6, 1467/P/7, 1467/P/8, 1467/P/9, 1467/P/10, 1467/P/11, 1467/P/12, 1467/P/13, 1467/P/14A.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until full details of a Biodiversity Mitigation and Enhancement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include:</p><p><br></p><p>(a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Mitigation and Enhancement Plans</p><p>(b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Plans and drawings showing the location of the nest boxes, bat boxes and bat bricks</p><p>(c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Specification of 4x nest boxes including at least 2 built in sparrow terraces on the property.</p><p>(d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Specification of 3x bat boxes (including 1x built in bat boxes or bat bricks)</p><p>(e)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Plans showing the protection/ buffer area to protect the woodland ground flora and existing trees.</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details approved and maintained.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence (except for demolition works) until full details and samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:</p><p><br></p><p>(a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the extension/building(s)</p><p>(b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>the ground surfacing</p><p>(c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>boundary treatment, including side access gates&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of works, all required tree protection fencing as detailed in the Arboricultural Impact Assessment (ref. GHA/DS/162240:24a), Arboricultural Impact Assessment Rev C and Tree Protection Plan, shall be in place. Photographic evidence of fencing in place shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted details of a secure cycle store shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the bin store next to the front entrance of the site as shown on the approved plans 1467/P/1A and 1467/P/14A shall only be used as a temporary location for bins on collection days. Details of bin stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved. The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved details set out in this condition.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</p>

<p>The completed schedule of site supervision and monitoring of tree protection measures as approved in Condition 6 shall be submitted for approval within 28 days of completion of development. Details shall include written evidence of compliance through contemporaneous supervision and monitoring of tree protection throughout the development and by the appointed specialist.</p>
<p>All approved Access Facilitation Pruning works shall be carried out in accordance with BS3998:2010. The development thereafter shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>No demolition or roof works can be carried out during the breeding bird season, unless a breeding bird check has been carried out within 24 hours of the works and submitted written evidence (letter or email) to prove that birds are not breeding at the time. Works can be carried out in the winter without restriction.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the of the development hereby permitted, details of the landscaping noted below shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority:</p><p><br></p><p>(a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Landscaping to be Approved – conversion - including landscape masterplan, hard and soft landscape details.</p><p>(b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Soft landscape works to include: Schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities&nbsp;</p><p>(c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken&nbsp;</p><p>(d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>A landscape implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works, including a period of 5 year period for replacements of soft landscape</p><p>(e)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Scheme of hardstanding with materials</p><p>(f)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Boundary treatment</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>
<p>The boundary vegetation should not be lit to afford protection to local bats foraging or commuting routes with dark corridors.</p>

<p>No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Detailed Construction Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Detailed Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:</p><p><br></p><p>a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors;</p><p>b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials; swept paths</p><p>c) Number of HGV’s anticipated;</p><p>d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;</p><p>e) Programme of work and phasing;</p><p>f) Site layout plan;</p><p>g) Highway condition (before, during, after);</p><p>h) Measures to control dust and dirt during construction;</p><p>i) Demolition method statement</p><p>j) Sitting and details of wheel washing facilities</p><p>k) Cleaning of site entrances, site tracks and the adjacent public highway</p><p>l) Timing of construction activities (including delivery times and removal of waste) and to avoid school pick up/drop off times</p><p>m) Post construction restoration/reinstatement of the working areas</p><p>n) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works; and</p><p>o) details showing the frontage/ the boundary of the site enclosed by site hording to a minimum height of 2 metres.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development, except for demolition works, hereby approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p><br></p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:&nbsp;</p><p>a) for fire appliances to be positioned on&nbsp;</p><p>b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than works of demolition) until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p><br></p><p>(a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Sustainable Drainage Systems Strategy (SuDS)&nbsp;</p><p>(b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Disposal of Surface Water</p><p>(c)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Disposal of Sewage</p><p>(d)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Surface Water Attenuation and Storage</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>
description: Demolition and redevelopment to provide detached dwellinghouse with habitable roofspace; dormer windows; solar panels; attached garage; replacement timber posts and gates; hard and soft landscaping
